They currently compete in the [[Eerste Divisie]]. They were founded 18 August 1965, as FC Den Bosch/BVV. They are the successor of BVV (1906) and Wilhelmina (1890). Their stadium is called '[[De Vliert]]', an 6,500 all-seater. [[Ruud van Nistelrooy]] started his professional career at this club.
